about: Both units are approved. Then a copy step stands in for the writer rewording u2's source line in the Brain Dump doc after the run started. `pointers` writes u1's pointer. It can't find u2's source line, so it writes no pointer for u2, undoes u2 as Milestone 9's undo does (its copy leaves idea-mara, which is back to its start), marks b1-u2 undone, and saves the line in .runs/{run-id}/pointer-misses.json. The undo itself missed nothing, so undo-misses.json is []. The writer's reworded line stays. The real Edit guard flags the writer's change as unexplained-change (no unit explains it) and nothing else.
readings: pointer-misses.json's text is the source line's record text, the line `pointers` looked for.
A unit undone by `pointers` keeps its place in the unit index and becomes undone with pointed_lines [].
The undo `pointers` runs writes undo-misses.json, [] when it missed nothing (CONTRACT.md 5.3 item 10).
An Edit guard flag with no unit has unit "" (spec-edit-guard.md 05 item 2: 'or is empty').
CONTRACT.md section 2 'Comparing' item 3 and test_cases.py don't list pointer-misses.json, so the runner doesn't compare the expected file here until the runner adds it.
